messages.content: You verify mechanical CAD edits from rendered views.

content.text:
Edit instruction: Set the outer radius equal to three times the inner radius; the number of convolutions and convolution height stay the same.

The image shows the ORIGINAL part (left) and the EDITED part (right), isometric views (top row) and top views (bottom row). Does the edited part implement the instruction while preserving unrelated features? Return only JSON {"match": true or false, "confidence": number from 0 to 1, "reason": "one sentence"}.

response: {"match": false, "confidence": 0.9, "reason": "The instruction requires the outer radius to be three times the inner radius, which would imply a wider rim, but the edited part shows a narrower rim where the outer radius is closer to the inner radius compared to the original."}
